profile_text.body:
The Alignment Research Center, which goes by ARC, is a non-profit research organization founded in 2021 and based in Berkeley, California. Its stated mission is to align future machine learning systems with human interests. The organization describes its motivation this way: it expects new techniques will be needed to align AI systems as they surpass human capabilities, and that as AI progress accelerates it may become harder to adapt quickly enough to keep up with changing technology. ARC says it would be better prepared with methods that could be safely scaled over many orders of magnitude, in the way generative pretraining and reinforcement learning have been scaled up over the past decade.

The center's own site presents it as a research organization rather than a product company, and no products or MCP servers are listed for it. No lawsuits are recorded against it. Its recorded law exposure is in California, with a count of 278.
